analysis:
Reviewed the complete supplied BASE test file, HEAD excerpt and patch, including additions beyond the HEAD excerpt. scripts/test-provider-release-pipeline.py:16–24 adds read-only script inspection and step extraction; :209–215 replaces the blanket failure-policy assertion with narrowly named runtime-facts exceptions. The added tests (HEAD patch lines 461–568) assert final-archive hash checking, signing-keychain removal before CLI execution, an empty CLI environment, bounded execution, explicit per-environment opt-in, required facts when included in publication, and diagnostic retention without secrets. Existing source-gating, artifact/provenance binding, signing, publication separation and qualification assertions remain intact. No independently supported security regression exists in these test-only changes; textual assertions are not evidence that the referenced implementations enforce the contracts.
Integration should examine .github/workflows/release-provider.yml, scripts/provider-cluster-runtime-facts.sh, scripts/provider-cluster-runtime-models.py and publication/runtime-facts implementations to verify credential isolation, fetched metadata validation, archive-to-facts binding, and that optional facts failures cannot bypass mandatory signing or authorization checks. Relevant contracts are A-005/A-011/A-017 and T-054/T-055/T-056: release runtime facts must not become independent qualification, hardware-capacity or correct-computation authority. Those implementations are outside this supplied source scope, leaving material cross-file uncertainty. No changes to inference encryption, prompt exposure, billing or provider admission are directly implemented here.
